AlertDefinition.name: Item Assignment
AlertDefinition.Source: select s from PcmAlertSubscription s left join s.user u where s.alertType = 'ItemAssignment' and s.subscribeFlag = 1 and exists (select im.itemKey from ItemAssignment a inner join a.item im inner join s.user where im.itemKey = to_number(:itemKey) and u.userId = a.userId and lower(a.userId) like lower(:assignee) and exists ( select 1 from PcmResponsibility resp inner join resp.roles as role where resp.responsibilityKey = a.responsibility))

Detail.Label: @{name} alert for @{item}
Detail.Body: Responsibility @{responsibility} has been assigned to @{receiver} for item @{item} by @{actor}

List.name: ItemAssignmentResponsibility
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Responsibility' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or lower(o.optionValue) = lower(:responsibility)))
